Tern Queue deployment status
Record: doc-022
Date: 2025-05-10
Collection: Fictional queue-study archive

Current configuration at the pilot cutoff: retry-gate notifications are enabled only in the supervised, single-client local pilot. The retained journal remains the durability fallback. Batch export and unattended rollout remain disabled.

The local approval is [[doc-004]], the fallback decision is [[doc-007]], and the latest boundary record is [[doc-010]]. The proposed flush-marker change has not been installed in this configuration. The next decision awaits the outstanding campaign review conditions.
